Messages.Author: Martin Filion
Messages.Body:
Hi!
   I have another question about Jyhad (I almost play 3 games per day so I
see lots of things in this game).

   I have a Sports Bike on a vampire which gives +1 Intercept.  Lets assume
for example an opposing vampire decides to bleed at +1 Stealth.  I decide to
use my Sports Bike to intercept him.  He puts another +1 Stealth, and his
able to bleed me since I don't have any intercept to play.

1. Must I tap the vampire to use the intercept on the Sports Bike?

2. In the case I must tap the vampire to use the intercept, can I uptap
   the vampire since I didn't go in combat with the opposing vampire?

   I never tapped my vampire to use my Intercept, but my friend told me
that if I don't tap the vampire using the Sports Bike, it could give a
confusion to how many intercepts I can take from the Sports Bike.
Anyway...  Having an answer on this would clarify him.

                                                Martin Filion
                                                Montreal, Qb

Messages.Author: Brian Wilson
Messages.Body:
Before I could do anything to stop it, Martin Filion wrote:

> 1. Must I tap the vampire to use the intercept on the Sports Bike?

> 2. In the case I must tap the vampire to use the intercept, can I uptap
>    the vampire since I didn't go in combat with the opposing vampire?

A vampire with a Sports Bike just *has* +1 intercept... you don't have to 
do anything to use it. You only tap the vampire after it successfully 
blocks. If this vampire successfully blocks and is tapped, you can use 
Wak with Evening's Freshness, Rat's Warning, etc., to revive it, and it 
will *still* have +1 interecept... it doesn't get "used" up in any way.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Your minion has to tap to equip with the Sport Bike, but once she/he/it
has it, the minion doesn't tap to make use of it.  Note that you're
not *forced* to use equipment, so you can ignore the Sport Bike if you
want to play and intercept card (superior Spirit's Touch, for example).
But yes, once you have the Sport Bike, the intercept is essentially free.
